Why bundled property services pay back

The classic FM structure &mdash; a managing agent, a hard-FM contractor, a soft-FM contractor and a small-works contractor &mdash; loses weeks at every handoff. A defect reported to the agent, passed to hard FM, escalated because it needs minor works, quoted by the small-works contractor, referred to the client, then finally instructed, has typically taken three weeks before anyone starts. On a P2 or P3 defect that is not unusual. On a portfolio it accumulates into avoidable void periods and eroded rental cover.

A single contract covering statutory compliance, PPM, reactive, minor works and voids removes those handoffs. The same helpdesk logs it, the same engineer attends, and if it is beyond the visit's remit the same team quotes the works and returns to complete them. The saving is not just cost per job; it is programme, cover and the amount of the client's time consumed managing the contractors.

Frequently asked questions

What is in scope?

Statutory compliance (EICR, gas safety, FRA, fire door inspections, L8 legionella, asbestos, LOLER, PAT), PPM (fabric, MEP, grounds), reactive maintenance on P1/P2/P3 SLAs, minor works, voids and turnaround, and portfolio-level capex planning. Anything outside those bands is quoted as a separate project.

What does statutory compliance actually cover?

The core statutory items for most non-domestic and multi-let residential property are: Fixed Wire Testing (EICR) to BS 7671; annual gas safety inspection (Gas Safe); Fire Risk Assessment (Regulatory Reform (Fire Safety) Order 2005 and the Fire Safety Act 2021); fire door inspections per the Fire Safety (England) Regulations 2022; legionella risk assessment per HSG274 / L8; asbestos duty to manage per CAR 2012; LOLER lift inspections every six months; and PAT testing per HSE guidance.

What reactive response times can we expect?

P1 (make safe / uninhabitable / significant loss): 2 to 4 hours in central London, up to 6 hours in outer boroughs and the Home Counties. P2 (significant impact but safe): next working day. P3 (routine): within 5 working days. Definitions are written into the contract so both sides agree on what triggers each priority.

Do you cover HMOs and PRS blocks?

Yes. HMO compliance (including licensing conditions, room sizes per HMO Management Regulations 2018, and fire strategy per LACORS / BS 9991) and PRS block compliance (including the Building Safety Act 2022 obligations on higher-risk residential buildings) are common contract scopes. Selective licensing conditions vary between boroughs and are tracked per asset.

What is the difference between TFM and bundled services?

Total Facilities Management typically bundles hard FM, soft FM, security, catering and reception under one contract; it fits large corporate estates. Bundled property services (PPM plus reactive plus minor works plus voids), which we offer, fits residential portfolios, mixed-use blocks and commercial owners without on-site staff, where the value is in removing the handoffs rather than in adding on-site presence.

Can you integrate with our CAFM?

Yes. Where the client uses Elogbooks, Concept Evolution, MRI, Yardi or another CAFM, jobs are logged and closed through the client's system in parallel with ours, and monthly data is reconciled. Where the client has no CAFM, our own cloud CAFM is provided with a client portal at no additional charge.
